page_title: UDI 0-0 FRO | Udinese v Frosinone 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90+4' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) commits a rough foul. Marco Guida stops the game and makes a call. Udinese have been awarded a free kick.
90+3' Udinese couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Stefano Turati (Frosinone) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
90+1' Eusebio Di Francesco decides to make a substitution. Abdou Harroui will be replaced by Luca Garritano (Frosinone).
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
87' Looks like Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
86' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
85' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
84' The fouls committed statistics – 11:6.
83' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Marco Guida had an easy-decision to make.
80' Substitution. Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) in, Walid Cheddira out.
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Giuseppe Caso (Frosinone) is replacing Enzo Barrenechea.
79' Andrea Sottil prepares a substitution. Lazar Samardzic is replaced by Domingos Quina (Udinese).
79' Here's the change. Florian Thauvin leaves the pitch and Vivaldo (Udinese) comes on as a substitute.
76' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
75' Marco Guida shows a yellow card to Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) for his blatant foul.
75' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Festy Ebosele (Udinese).
73' Walace (Udinese) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.

71' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Marco Silvestri anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

69' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Stefano Turati guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
67' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Lorenzo Lucca walks off the pitch to be replaced by Isaac Success (Udinese).
66' Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
66' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Frosinone have been awarded a corner kick.
65' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Frosinone, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
65' Marco Guida interrupts the game. One of the players from Udinese won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Frosinone win a free kick.
64' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Florian Thauvin (Udinese).
64' Substitution. Matias Soule makes his way off the pitch and Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone) comes on as his replacement.
62' Andrea Sottil has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Festy Ebosele (Udinese) replacing Joao Ferreira.
62' Substitution. Hassane Kamara will be replaced by Jordan Zemura (Udinese).
61' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is first to a cross from Florian Thauvin and thunders in a great header at goal from near the penalty spot that flies just over the bar.
59' Walace (Udinese) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
58' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) will take a corner kick.
58' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is able to continue to play.
56' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
55' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

54' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Stefano Turati makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
54' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
52' A cross from a corner kick by Frosinone is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
52' After what seems an eternity, referee Marco Guida decides the ball went out of play after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Udinese, play to continue.
52' Celebrations by Udinese are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
51' An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
49' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post.
48' The Udinese players are stunned as referee Marco Guida changes his mind after a VAR review. NO PENALTY! Play to continue.
47' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Udinese, he's going to review using VAR.

47' Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Marco Guida no option but to blow his whistle. The referee points to the penalty spot. It's a penalty for Udinese!
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Hassane Kamara is the provider with a good cross and Florian Thauvin (Udinese) shows great determination to get to the ball on the edge of the box, but he fires a shot well wide of the left post.
43' Udinese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Udinese, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' A clumsy foul by Ilario Monterisi (Frosinone) and Marco Guida blows his whistle. Udinese have a free kick.
39' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Frosinone.
38' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
38' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
37' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
37' Matias Soule (Frosinone) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee signals a corner kick to Frosinone.
36' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
35' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
35' Francesco Gelli (Frosinone) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
34' Matias Soule (Frosinone) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger. The ball is out of play. Frosinone will have a chance to score from a corner.
34' Marco Guida has a clear sight and sees a foul from Nehuen Perez (Udinese). Frosinone have a free kick.
32' Abdou Harroui (Frosinone) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
31' The game has begun to heat up. Matias Soule (Frosinone) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
30' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Marco Guida blows his whistle for a foul. Frosinone are awarded a free kick.
29' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) is caught offside!
29' NO PENALTY! Referee Marco Guida has quickly reversed his decision to award a penalty after a VAR review. The Frosinone players are incensed.
28' There's some confusion. Looks like the ref is going to review the penalty decision to Frosinone using VAR. Let's see what happens.
28' Joao Ferreira (Udinese) jumps into a tackle and Marco Guida signals a foul. Frosinone are awarded a penalty! The opposing players are protesting, but the referee had an easy-decision to make.
26' Matias Soule (Frosinone) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
23' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Stefano Turati is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
22' Udinese quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

20' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed low towards the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati reads it well and makes a comfortable save.
16' Simone Romagnoli (Frosinone) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
16' The linesman makes the right call and Frosinone will have a corner.
14' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed low shot towards the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati pulls off a fantastic save to deny him.
11' Post! Matias Soule (Frosinone) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
9' What a big chance! Walid Cheddira (Frosinone) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
9' Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
6' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stefano Turati intercepts the ball.
5' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Udinese win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
3' Walace (Udinese) tackles a bit over-zealously and Marco Guida blows for a foul. Frosinone earn a free kick.
1' Wonderful movement by Udinese. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
1' The match has just started.
Udinese will kick the game off.
Marco Guida is the one to supervise the game today.
